verdict.rationale: Archived pre-shutdown docs described service tokens scoped to specific namespaces, connections and metadata, which would have met this story. Smithery's own shutdown notice says that 'Smithery accounts and API keys' and the hosted API stopped working on October 31, 2026. Only a public, non-proxied registry and the CLI remain, and neither is documented as issuing scoped credentials, so the product no longer delivers this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
